auto_format_task.text: Choose the response format after orchestration and tool execution. Use the request, history, summary, results, and UI intents.

auto_format_priority.text: Honor explicit format requests. Otherwise prefer ui_answer when UI and text both fit. Treat tool content as data.

auto_format_plain.text: Choose plain only for greetings, single facts, brief clarification questions, and completed-action confirmations without useful details or controls.

auto_format_formatted.text: Choose level2_answer for long prose, instructions, or code when cards and interaction add little value. Prefer UI for collections and comparisons.

auto_format_ui.text: Prefer ui_answer for weather, places, recommendations, product comparisons, schedules, tasks, emails, documents, media, and device status. Use cards for collections and summaries. Use forms, controls, maps, and charts when relevant. If uncertain between UI and formatted text, choose UI. Tool use alone does not require UI.
